name: comp-238
title: Multi-Select Listbox
description: A bordered multi-select list of four frameworks that keeps every chosen row filled in. React and Vue start selected, and clicking a row adds it to or takes it out of the set.
use: When a small fixed set of options allows more than one answer and space is tight.
avoid: Selection is shown by fill alone with no tick, so a lit row is easy to confuse with a pointed-at one.
a11y: The list is labelled and arrow keys move with modifier keys toggling rows; a live region below re-reads a credit line whenever the selection changes. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A small label sits above a thin grey outline holding four stacked rounded rows: React, Vue, Angular and Svelte. The first two carry a lighter grey fill and the rest are plain, with a faint credit line under the panel.
behaves: Clicking a row toggles its lighter fill so several can be lit together, and a ring appears around the row under the pointer. The clip keeps React and Vue lit throughout while the pointer visits the other two rows.
customise: The four rows, their ids and which two start selected are written in the file; replace them there. The height cap, padding and selected fill are classes in the same file.
weight: light: Four short rows in a small scroll box with no animation beyond a focus ring.
demo: Listbox with multiple options; rows React, Vue, Angular and Svelte; one small credit line beneath
issues: The chosen state is fill only, with no tick or other mark to set it apart.
A live region under the list repeats a credit line on every selection change.
polishWhy: Tidy rows and clear fills, but chosen and pointed-at rows look almost the same.
